shared_elements: dense low-relief carving covering an architectural stone surface
band of repeated small motifs (glyph blocks / crenellations)
architectural stonework with stepped or blocky masonry
justification: Both depict human figures in low relief on monumental stone architecture, with rows of repeated small motifs (glyph-like blocks in A, crenellations in B), but this is a generic correspondence of relief-carved standing figures. A shows a single vertically stacked column of frontal, heavily ornamented figures with dense hieroglyphic panels on an isolated slab, while B shows a horizontal processional frieze of profile figures flanked by lion-and-bull combat groups beneath a colonnade — different compositions, orientations, figural conventions, and no shared distinctive motif.
